notes.title: Join the Devs of The Best Armor Smashing Simulation Game - Part 2
notes.notes:
Hi all (^_^)y , welcome to join us on Steam for our second Next Fest live stream on Oct 8th at 3:00PM  (Mountain Time).
Again, we'll have some live gameplay, feature showcase, Q&A etc. Also we can demonstrate any features on you demand, just leave your comment in the discussion. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635458/1625d2306311d71e94882e39ba9a5566bd6ad888.png[/img]

Armed and Armoured is a medieval sword fighting game in which your blade CANNOT simply cut through armor. We also provided a more realistic, fast paced, sword combat system. Our current demo is only a test for combat balancing. The final game product will include an RPG single player campaign and several multiplayer modes for PvP gameplays.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41635458/4acde303692ddefc485c4e4b36f67672d5aa4ba5.png[/img]

Now, our dev team is also collaborating closely with a United States archeology group, Maryland Saga. Their expertise in historical sword and armor combat provides great feed backs. And we are adjusting our combat system, weapon balancing, armor damage model based on their advice.
  
Maryland Saga is a Viking age living history group. With a focus on the martial practices, and day to day lives of people from the Viking age.
Maryland Saga uses archeological finds, and documents describing the time period combined with experimental archeology and various skills from its members to recreate a realistic image of Viking age lifestyle and combat.
Pls checkout their Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/MarylandSaga/

Although the current version of Armed and Armoured is not a Viking age game... yet. But if our team can survive on this game. A DLC or a series of game is always possible ; )
